# Lenis

The React accordion's additional bundled licenses are retained separately in ../react/THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt. It uses React/React DOM, Lucide React, clsx, tailwind-merge and compiled Tailwind CSS. Its seven illustrative Unsplash photographs are credited in ../about/CREDITS.md.

Version: 1.3.27, pinned and hosted locally as lenis-1.3.27.min.js with the recommended lenis-1.3.27.css stylesheet. Both distribution files are unchanged.

Author: darkroom.engineering. License: MIT; the full terms are in LENIS-LICENSE.txt.

Source: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis/tree/v1.3.27

Distribution: https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.3.27/dist/lenis.min.js and https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.3.27/dist/lenis.css (downloaded at development time; no runtime CDN dependency).

# React Bits Micro Slats

Author: David Haz, copyright 2026. The shaders and fluid logic in micro-slats.js are adapted for this portfolio from React Bits, with the React lifecycle replaced by a vanilla browser lifecycle and motion/visibility controls.

Source revision: d01aa914dcbe76da8b2923ebf872b5c8b1066e4c

Source: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/d01aa914dcbe76da8b2923ebf872b5c8b1066e4c/src/content/Backgrounds/MicroSlats/MicroSlats.jsx

Reference: https://reactbits.dev/backgrounds/micro-slats

License: MIT + Commons Clause. The full original license is included in REACT-BITS-LICENSE.md. This is embedded in the personal portfolio website; it is not offered as a standalone or redistributed component product. Changes include a green/charcoal palette, static fallback, explicit pause, dynamic reduced-motion support, visibility suspension, smaller GPU budgets and resource cleanup.

# OGL

Version: 1.0.11, pinned and locally hosted as ogl-1.0.11.min.js. The browser bundle contains only Renderer, Program, Mesh, Triangle, RenderTarget and Texture and their dependencies. It was prepared with esbuild 0.25.12; esbuild is not needed by the public website or for future content edits.

Author: Nathan Gordon. License: Unlicense/public domain; the standard terms are included in OGL-LICENSE.txt.

Package/source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ogl/v/1.0.11 and https://github.com/oframe/ogl

Input distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/ogl@1.0.11/+esm (downloaded at development time, no CDN requests at runtime).
